quirks: Uses Google Gemini generateContent request/response format, not a simple {prompt} field.
Image comes back as base64 in candidates[0].content.parts[].inlineData.data; find the part that has inlineData (other parts may carry thoughtSignature/text).
For editing/composition, add an inlineData part to contents with mimeType + base64 source image alongside the text instruction.
Response is large (~1.8MB) because the JPEG is embedded inline as base64.
usage.guide: POST to the URL with JSON body {"contents":[{"parts":[{"text":"<your prompt>"}]}],"generationConfig":{"responseModalities":["IMAGE"]}}; payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.05 per call, no API key. The response is synchronous Gemini format: decode body.candidates[0].content.parts[].inlineData.data (base64) using the sibling inlineData.mimeType to get the generated image. Add generationConfig.imageConfig.aspectRatio to control shape, or include an inlineData source-image part in contents for editing/composition.
